name: Chimp Panini Vr
summary:
🥪 Welcome to Chimp Panini! 🥪

Think you’ve got the speed to handle the press? Chimp Panini takes the classic VR physics-movement formula and turns up the heat!

Jump into lobbies with friends, master crazy momentum leaps, and swing through custom-built maps built for competitive tag and chill hangout sessions alike. We’re constantly updating the game with new cosmetics, feature drops, and map expansions.

What to expect:
🏃 Fluid Mechanics: Tight, responsive hand-movement physics.
